fields.description: The line's subject in Central: the Grove team id.
fields.label: Team

fields.description: The model key, the line's dimension. Blank for a correction that names no model.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: The UTC landing day: the UTC date the Usage Records were created in Grove.
fields.label: Day

fields.description: Pending: sent again next hour. Confirmed: Central accepted the value sent. Refused: Central rejected it and said not to retry; sent again only when the day's value changes.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The day's cost last sent, in nano-USD.
fields.label: Value Sent

fields.description: The as_of of the last report that carried the line (site time).
fields.label: As Of

fields.description: When the line was last sent (site time).
fields.label: Sent At

fields.description: When Central last accepted the line (site time). Blank unless Confirmed.
fields.label: Confirmed At

fields.description: Central's reason for the last rejection: why a Pending line is retried or a Refused one held.
fields.label: Reason
